text:
Give the explainer site a front page about Athena and one page per study. Today xtask/src/site.rs renders a single study (a STUDY_DIR constant) into one index.html whose headings name firstmate, and Athena's own introduction lives in firstmate's intro.json "about" block. The latest newcomer rating (records/audience-ratings/2026-10/20261017-095516-gw15.json) says a visitor who came to learn about Athena mostly reads about firstmate. BRIEF.md D2 asks for a learning path plus free exploration.
Plan: (1) A new studies/index.json holds the front page's content: Athena in three sentences, what the study is (prompts as the primary artifact; statement, claim, pinned lines; read versus observed), and the order of studies. (2) The front page at / shows that content, a "Try Athena" link first, then "Pick a system" with one card per study directory: the system, one cited line from its intro, the mechanism, the pinned commit and tag, and the evidence kind derived from its claim marks ("read only" when every claim is read). A study without intro.json shows "in progress". (3) Each study renders at /<study-id>/ with today's renderer plus a breadcrumb back to /; the "about" block becomes optional, and the front page takes Athena's introduction from studies/index.json. (4) Record the structure, with the alternatives considered, in docs/design/explainer-site.md.
Acceptance:
- cargo test: `cargo run -p xtask -- site --out <dir>` (or the equivalent function) writes index.html and firstmate-work-handling/index.html, and a test follows the link from the front page to the study page and back.
- cargo test: the firstmate page equals the old renderer's output except for the breadcrumb (a test strips the breadcrumb and compares); the existing site tests pass unmodified.
- cargo test: the front page's title and first heading name Athena, "Try Athena" comes before "Pick a system", and no studied system is named before "Pick a system".
- cargo test: a synthetic second study directory gets a card and a page; without intro.json its card says "in progress"; a malformed studies/index.json fails the build naming the file; a study whose claims are all read shows "read only".
- clippy with -D warnings and fmt --check are clean; CHANGELOG.md has an entry; no file under studies/firstmate-work-handling/ changes.
Out of scope: Hermes content, design tokens and visual identity changes, and the pages workflow beyond a comment.
